finalists.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST)
finalists.why: It has the most decisive findings in the vignette, including a large submucosal bulging mass and a well-defined, homogeneous, oval mass arising from the posterior gastric wall.

finalists.label: Lipoma
finalists.why: It has specific findings that are not shared with its rivals, including fat-tissue attenuation with central contrast enhancement and trabecular architecture.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it accounts for the most decisive findings in the vignette, including the large submucosal bulging mass and the well-defined, homogeneous, oval mass, despite the presence of fat-tissue attenuation which is more specific to Lipoma.
